purpose: Teach: 宿舎/華麗/赤外線/右脳/速記/接着/解像度/諸島

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが軍の宿舎で生活された
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he lived in the military quarters.
lines.style: Soft, drifting voice. Gentle nostalgia — not quite a question, not quite a statement. Pauses slightly before each memory, as if retrieving it from distance. Warm but inward.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、華麗な舞踏会のお写真お持ちだったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — Grandpa, he had those lovely photographs from the formal ball, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Affectionate and slightly teasing. A gentle correction wrapped in warmth. She speaks with the easy confidence of someone who was there too. Light, present, eyes crinkling.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが赤外線ストーブを愛用された
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he loved using that infrared heater.
lines.style: Continuing the soft thread of memory. Voice dips slightly — intimate, as if sharing something small and tender. Lets the image sit for a moment before moving on.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、右脳教育の本を読まれてたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, you were always reading those books about right-brain learning, weren't you, dear?
lines.style: Playful redirect. She's gently turning the lens back on him, with knowing affection. A small laugh underneath. Testing him a little — lovingly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが速記者の妹さんを誇りにされた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he was so proud of his stenographer sister.
lines.style: Voice quiets further. A thread of real pride in his voice — not his own, but he honors it. Reverent and simple. Lets the fact stand on its own weight.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ご自分で家具の接着修理をされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, you were the one who fixed all the furniture with glue, weren't you, dear?
lines.style: Warmth with a hint of admiration. She's naming something practical he did, something that mattered. Not flattering — just noticing. Direct and gentle.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが高解像度の双眼鏡をお持ちだった
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he had those wonderful high-powered binoculars.
lines.style: The memory grows more vivid now. A small smile in the voice. Slower pace — he's seeing it. The detail matters. Tender and precise at once.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、伊豆諸島の旅をご家族で楽しまれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, you took the whole family to the Izu Islands, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Soft close — the final memory lands gently. She's wrapping it up with warmth and finality. Her voice fades slightly at the end, like a benediction. Satisfied, complete.
